server.name: community-desktop-commander
server.note: The most downloaded locally runnable server in the registry frame (about 196k weekly npm downloads). It declares readOnlyHint on all 25 tools and idempotentHint on none, so a client has nothing to decide a retry with. HOME moves into the trial root because the server writes a call log and its config under ~/.claude-server-commander.
